reviews.comment: While she spoke very fast in lecture, the practice/labs were very helpful to become familiar with the material and being able to execute the visualizations as needed for exams. Basically like one of the LinkedinLearnings but a full class. No busywork, mainly application and some group projects to show skill, and she is available to help.

This class taught necessary skills and will be useful in the future. However the professor is impossible to reach outside of class. She also is very vague when she answers your questions. Also takes as long as possible to put in grades so don't be surprised if your grade still isn't in 3 weeks after the final.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class is valuable for sure. That being said, the professor takes FOREVER to get grades back and gives very poor feedback. My peers and I had a hard time communicating with/ reaching her outside of class. Instructions are vague for the group projects. The class isn't hard if you put the effort in, but she can be difficult to work with.

Dr. Mosely's course is a fantastic intro to data visualization and Tableau. There's a great balance between lectures and group labs, which help you practice and are excellent for exam prep. She provides guided videos on Canvas to help with labs if you get stuck and is always available for questions. She also gives partial credit on exams!

Dr. Mosley's grad level viz course was tough. The lab's she gave us were easy to follow and made it easy to understand, but her exams were a different story. If you have a Tableau background before coming into this class, you're set. If not, the buckle up and be ready for these exams. She also was always late with uploading our assignments.

This class is pretty much a waste of time, You could learn this stuff on YouTube instead of spending money on it. She takes to long to get grades back and she is also lazy and won't help her students when they need it even though the fix probably would take long. I would to try to avoid this class but I think its mandatory so find another teacher.

Save your time and avoid her classes at all costs. She probably hasn't thought of college in the past and lacks experience in the environment. I could have watched the same videos somewhere else for free and probably gotten more out of them. Her modules were at many times irrelevant and lacked consistency. My worst professor by far at TAMU.
